effective_rule: registered only when this file is merged to main with status 'registered', effective_utc set to the merge time and effective_evidence naming the merge commit; opportunities before that are not prospective evidence; nothing is backfilled as live

instrument.universe: BTC only; no point-in-time universe expansion without a new registration

schedule.basis: measured Oct 12-19 2026 (research_tools/panel.py (panel-1.0.0) at cutoff fce9fa2): perp input age at the decision clock median 180 s, p90 300 s at :00 (300-480 s at other offsets), max 900 s

inputs.allowed: research_tools/panel.py panel-1.1.0 features with fstate 'ok' at the decision time (flow_liquidity, price_response, funding_dispersion, positioning_interaction, spot_perp_basis); each feature's age is its sources' age (dir1_runner.FEATURE_SOURCES)
inputs.missing: a required feature not eligible (panel.eligible) or older than max_input_age_s: inputs-unavailable, recorded with reasons, never filled

horizon_basis: 4h = about 48x the p90 input age; a tens-of-minutes horizon would sit within a few multiples of the measured lag

forecast.representation: p_up: probability that the 240-minute forward log return from the first eligible quote is positive
forecast.target: common to every arm: 240-minute log return from the open of the first 1m bar at or after decision + publication.deadline_s + execution.delay_s (no arm can know it at publication); Brier is scored on its sign

conversion.sizing: fixed unit; sizing is not tested here

publication.durable: a git commit on main of the forecast record whose content sha256 equals the forecast's, or a registry write with receipt and read-back; the durable copy's own time is the publication time
publication.late: published after the deadline: recorded as publish-late and graded as its own class, never as on-time
publication.verification: research_tools/dir1_runner.GitHubMainVerifier (first push to main containing the commit, from GitHub's activity records, with the file's exact bytes) or RegistryReceiptVerifier; a caller or Git author timestamp is never the publication time

execution.entry: latency-aware, per arm: open of the first 1m bar starting at or after max(decision, the arm's verified publication) + delay_s
execution.exit: close of the bar ending entry + 240 min
execution.unavailable: no eligible bar within 2 h: ungradable
execution.price_basis: bar-based paper price proxy (1m bar open/close); not an observed executable quote

costs.funding: settled Binance funding at every 8-hourly settlement in (entry, exit], signed by side (a long pays a positive rate); any settlement missing: net value unavailable for that opportunity, never zero
costs.inference: every attempt's cost in USD recorded (unknown when a call is cancelled) and reported beside trading economics, not netted against them; no capital convention converts it
costs.basis: assumptions stated here; taker tier not observed

inference.model_pinning: a pinned model version where the provider offers one; an alias is recorded as an alias and every observed version string is kept

arm_definitions.statistical: research_tools/directional.fit_logistic on panel features, training cutoff before effective_utc, artifact validated (research_api.validate_statistical_artifact) and its hash frozen at registration
arm_definitions.frontier: a model call on the same permitted inputs through dir1_runner.CommandAdapter or HTTPJSONAdapter with a pinned identity; NOT commissioned (no model account, identity or transport is configured in this repository)
arm_definitions.text-event: gated: no point-in-time text/event capture exists

evaluation.primary: paired difference in mean Brier score, statistical minus baseline (comparisons.primary), on the pair-specific intersection with the full scheduled denominator beside it
secondary: frontier arms when commissioned, as challengers
evaluation.dependence: overlapping 4h horizons on hourly decisions: 4-hour blocks with research_tools/calibration.block_bootstrap_ci (>= 20 blocks), calibrated by research_tools/calibration_harness.py before any promotion
evaluation.promotion: a challenger replaces nothing until it beats the incumbent at a checkpoint on the paired comparison; it inherits no evidence
evaluation.retirement: adjusted interval wholly unfavourable at a checkpoint, or operator stop

comparisons.challengers: frontier arms, when commissioned, are compared to the incumbent as separately registered secondary pairs; adding one never changes the primary pair

evaluation.missing_policy: pair-specific intersection of on-time graded forecasts for each registered pair; full scheduled denominators, per-arm missing/late/failed/abstaining/ungradable counts and the joint coverage are reported beside every difference; no numeric score is invented for a missing forecast; a numeric forecast inside the abstention band is scored for probability quality and trades nothing
evaluation.late: publish-late forecasts are graded as their own class and excluded from the on-time comparisons

monitoring.operational_pause: inputs-unavailable or missed share > 20% over 24 h pauses the stream (an operational state, not a performance change)
monitoring.updates: a new model, prompt, tool policy or retrained artifact is a challenger arm with its own clock

revision_note: Oct 19 2026 (repo 2.30, still PREPARED, never registered): structured registered comparisons (F5: statistical minus baseline is the primary pair; arm order cannot change it); a common forecast target for every arm; settled-funding and missing-funding rule; bar-based price proxy label; inference cost reported separately; panel-1.1.0 inputs with per-source age; operational path research_tools/dir1_runner.py; stale lab/* references replaced by research_tools/*. Revision 1 is in git history.
